newsitem.title: UK: Triplex Lloyd looks at options on WmCook.
newsitem.headline: Triplex Lloyd looks at options on WmCook.

text.p: Triplex Lloyd Plc, the engineering company in the midst of a hostile takeover battle for specialist steel castings group William Cook Plc, said on Thursday it would consider its options after a counter offer launched today by a management-led team with venture capital backing. A spokeswoman for the group, whose latest offer launched earlier this week valued William Cook at about 74 million stg, said its initial reaction was that the mbo bid did nothing to address what it believes are deficiencies in the approach of William Cook's management led by executive chairman Andrew Cook.

"The company (Triplex) will be looking at its options, but I think the institutional investors should realise that this (mbo) is just a company that's been set up as a defensive move by this individual (Andrew Cook), who doesn't want to lose the reins he's been holding on to," the spokeswoman said.
She added that shareholders should consider that by opting for a deal with Triplex Lloyd, William Cook would become part of a group "that is going to grow it forwards".
The mbo bid, backed by venture capital company Electra Fleming, is offering 425 pence cash for each Cook share, valuing the group at about 80 million stg.
Triplex Lloyd's share-based bid is worth around 400 pence with a cash alternative of 383.4 pence.
